issues.issue: Whether the claimant's China persecution account (raid, bail, PSB summons) is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says his Falun Gong group was raided, he was detained on bail, and PSB still pursues him.
issues.result_text: Claimant not credible; bail letter, receipt and summons found not genuine; persecution account rejected.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is a genuine Falun Gong practitioner
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he practises Falun Gong in a group in Canada and practised in China.
issues.result_text: Claimant not a genuine practitioner in China as alleged; Canadian practice given little weight.

issues.issue: Whether the Canadian sur place activities were undertaken in good faith
issues.result_text: Activities in Canada begun only to support a fraudulent claim; no genuine sur place claim.
